answer.title: Automated Plumber Visit Rescheduling from Helpdesk
answer.trigger: A helpdesk ticket requests a plumber visit reschedule.
steps: Read the incoming helpdesk ticket details to identify the booking and requested new date.
Extract the target date and customer information using AI.
Locate the existing booking in the jobs system.
Update the booking schedule in the jobs system.
Reply to the customer in the helpdesk confirming the new date.
answer.ai_help: Extracts the requested new date and booking reference from the customer's helpdesk ticket.
answer.human_approval: Claire must approve changing the booking date in the jobs system.
answer.risk_reason: Rescheduling a job incorrectly could lead to missed appointments and unhappy customers.
